intentional_docstring_changes.documented:
Balanced VSPA:PE two-interval comparison acquisition core, version 1.8.

This module is independent of Tk and usable in offline tests. The existing v1.5
Arduino command behavior is retained; original source bytes are archived. Command acceptance and firmware timers
are software observations; neither establishes physical actuator motion.

intentional_docstring_changes.name: ProtocolConfig
intentional_docstring_changes.original: Round counts are independent; one full cycle has 5 + 5 + 8 trials.
intentional_docstring_changes.documented:
Defaults select 80 pair trials: 10 balanced rounds of eight ordered pairs.

    Optional singles add five fixed orientation trials and five per random
    single round. Ten enabled single rounds plus the default pairs total 135.

intentional_docstring_changes.name: build_schedule
intentional_docstring_changes.original:
Persist randomized, exactly balanced interval assignments per pair.

    The ten-round primary study has 80 trials: 8 pairs x 5 baseline and 5
    long. Each round has 4 baseline and 4 long to limit time drift.
intentional_docstring_changes.documented:
Construct randomized, exactly balanced interval assignments per pair.

    The default ten-round pair task has 80 trials: 8 pairs x 5 baseline and
    5 long. Each round has 4 baseline and 4 long to limit time drift. Optional
    single-finger blocks are additional; DataStore persists the returned plan.

intentional_docstring_changes.name: <module>
intentional_docstring_changes.original:
Analyze actual hardware-mode VSPA:PE v1.8 comparison trial logs.

Run after the experiment, not before. Never generates or imputes trial outcomes.
Shows valid/attempted sample sizes and separate rates for correct ordered response
and self-reported blending. Excludes simulated and incomplete sessions by default.

python3 analyze_timing.py --input experiment_output --output analysis_output
intentional_docstring_changes.documented:
Analyze actual hardware-mode VSPA:PE v1.8 comparison trial logs.

Run after the experiment, not before. Never generates or imputes trial outcomes.
Shows valid/attempted sample sizes and separate rates for correct ordered response
and self-reported blending. Excludes simulation sessions and other schema
versions. Partial hardware sessions retain eligible rows and are explicitly
flagged in session_integrity.csv; completeness is not an exclusion filter.

python3 analyze_timing.py --input experiment_output_v1_8 --output analysis_output

scope: Executable source equivalence; comments, four corrected __doc__ strings and source-byte provenance differ.
observable_documentation_changes: Source line numbers and future files_sha256 metadata reflect the documented source bytes.
